verdict: Organic presence is holding; paid channels and key pipeline steps need activation.
narrative: Across all three businesses this period, every engagement came from organic Google Business Profile activity — no paid advertising ran on Meta or Google Ads, so there are no leads or cost-per-lead figures to report. Combined GBP actions totalled 385 across Forte Precision Metals, Advance Grinding Services, and O'Hare Precision Metals, but momentum is softening: Advance Grinding is down 53% and O'Hare down 50% week-over-week, and search clicks are declining across both. Several CRM and outreach steps that underpin the lead pipeline are overdue, and resolving those is the immediate priority so outreach sequences and contact automation can start. With the SEO root-cause fix and contact pulls targeted for completion by September 30, the pipeline should begin moving in the next reporting period.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions across all three businesses in the last 28 days
week-over-week drop in GBP engagement for Advance Grinding Services — the sharpest decline this period
paid leads generated this period — no Meta or Google Ads spend ran across any entity

watch_item.issue: Two Google Business Profile listings for O'Hare (Precision Ground Metals and Precision Ground Bars) received direction requests but generated zero calls over 28 days, pointing to a possible issue with how the phone number or contact action appears on those profiles.
watch_item.fix: Both listings are being audited this week to confirm the phone field and call-to-action are displaying correctly.
